title: Savings Guarantee, Bill Credit Treatment and Certificate Ownership - Community Solar Subscriptions
content:
Every plan of Community Solar Subscriptions carries the Beacon Ridge savings guarantee: Beacon Ridge guarantees that the subscriber's annual fees never exceed the annual solar bill credits multiplied by 100 less the plan's discount percentage, divided by 100.

## Terms by plan

| Plan | Savings guarantee | When the guarantee is checked | How a shortfall is returned | Utility credits above the utility bill | Compensation for low project production | Annual savings report | Renewable energy certificates |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Flex | Yes | annually, on the allocation anniversary | invoice credit | carried forward by the utility | No | Yes | retained by the project owner |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 1-Year | Yes | annually, on the allocation anniversary | invoice credit | carried forward by the utility | No | Yes | retained by the project owner |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 5-Year | Yes | annually, on the allocation anniversary | invoice credit | carried forward by the utility | No | Yes | retained by the project owner |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 10-Year | Yes | annually, on the allocation anniversary | invoice credit | carried forward by the utility | No | Yes | retained by the project owner |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 20-Year | Yes | annually, on the allocation anniversary | invoice credit | carried forward by the utility | No | Yes | retained by the project owner |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible | Yes | annually, on the allocation anniversary | invoice credit | carried forward by the utility | No | Yes | retained by the project owner |

## Basis questions

**What does the guarantee promise?**
That the fees for a year never exceed that year's solar bill credits multiplied by 100 less the plan's discount percentage, divided by 100.

**How often is it checked?**
Once a year, on the anniversary of the allocation date.

**In what form is a shortfall returned?**
As a credit on the Beacon Ridge invoice.

**What happens to solar credits that are larger than the subscriber's utility bill?**
The utility carries them forward on its own bill.

**Is the subscriber compensated when the project produces less than expected?**
No. Low project production is not compensated beyond the discount on any plan.

**Does the subscriber receive a savings report?**
Yes, an annual savings report, on every plan.

**Who owns the renewable energy certificates of the project?**
The project owner retains them, on every plan.
